strict_advances.name: finite and slowly growing divisibility-chain cover density theorem
strict_advances.label: THEOREM
strict_advances.statement: For arbitrary activated residue classes in a fixed countable partition into strict divisibility chains, the survivor set has a natural density whenever the number h(X) of chains active by X is o(log X/log log X). For a fixed finite number of chains, the density also has an absolutely convergent CRT/lcm inclusion-exclusion formula.
strict_advances.scope: strict subclass; rapidly growing divisibility width remains open

strict_advances.name: arbitrary-rank Macaulay Galois meeting reduction
strict_advances.label: THEOREM
strict_advances.statement: With the forward residual capacities a_p and reverse minimum requirements b_p, a_(p+1)>=b_(p+1) iff a_p>=b_p. Thus exact comparison at any common rank certifies all colex capacities.
strict_advances.scope: the all-r middle-rank inequality is unproved; finite prefix growth does not prove an unbounded prefix
